# Agent Skills Library

A collection of 43 specialized coding agent skills for professional software development, including Flutter, Dart, and GitHub workflows. These skills help AI coding assistants (like Antigravity, Claude Code, Cursor, and Copilot) follow your project standards for architecture, testing, UI design, and CI/CD.

[View Live Documentation](https://dhruvanbhalara.github.io/skills/)

---

## Installation

Add these skills to your AI agent using the `skills` CLI:

```bash
# Add all skills to your workspace
npx skills add dhruvanbhalara/skills

# Add a specific skill (e.g., flutter-spm)
npx skills add dhruvanbhalara/skills --skill flutter-spm
```

---
